pages.title: Satranç Lobisi
pages.template_string:
<v-container>
  <v-row>
    <v-col cols="12" md="8">
      <v-card title="Satranç Odaları">
        <v-list>
          <v-list-item v-for="room in rooms" :key="room.id" :title="room.name" :subtitle="new Date(room.created_at).toLocaleString()">
            <template v-slot:append>
              <v-chip size="small" class="mr-2" :color="room.status === 'active' ? 'success' : 'grey'">{{ room.status }}</v-chip>
              <v-btn color="primary" size="small" @click="joinRoom(room.id)" :disabled="room.status !== 'active'">Katıl</v-btn>
            </template>
          </v-list-item>
          <v-list-item v-if="rooms.length === 0">
            <v-list-item-title class="text-grey">Henüz aktif bir satranç odası bulunmuyor.</v-list-item-title>
          </v-list-item>
        </v-list>
      </v-card>
    </v-col>
    <v-col cols="12" md="4">
      <v-card title="Yeni Oda Oluştur">
        <v-card-text>
          <v-text-field v-model="newRoomName" label="Oda Adı" @keyup.enter="createRoom"></v-text-field>
          <v-btn color="success" block @click="createRoom" :loading="loading">Oluştur</v-btn>
        </v-card-text>
      </v-card>
    </v-col>
  </v-row>
  <v-dialog v-model="showJoinDialog" max-width="400">
    <v-card title="Oyuna Katıl">
      <v-card-text>
        <v-text-field v-model="userName" label="Adınız (Nickname)" @keyup.enter="confirmJoin"></v-text-field>
        <v-btn color="primary" block @click="confirmJoin">Masaya Otur</v-btn>
      </v-card-text>
    </v-card>
  </v-dialog>
</v-container>
